sections.Profile:
The "Circus Wagon" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on August 5, 1955, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Wood Rail, Circus, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
